name: Jenny's Shrimp Truck
notes: Only third-party coverage found (Honolulu Magazine, Hawaii Magazine, Ang Sarap July 2025). No official website, Instagram or Facebook page surfaced, and I did not guess handles. Fixed roadside truck at 66-532 Kamehameha Hwy, Haleiwa, phone (808) 429-3522 per Hawaii Magazine. Hawaii Magazine lists hours of 9:30am-6:30pm daily, but that article is old. Latest evidence of operation is a July 2025 blog visit, so still_active is unconfirmed. Side: north_shore.

name: Kalbi On Fire
notes: Facebook page lists 56-505 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku and phone (808) 382-4654, which matches the truck. It is a fixed truck, so no market schedule was found. A 'weeblyte' menu site exists but looks like an auto-generated third-party page, so I did not treat it as the business's website. No Instagram found. A 2026 Giftly listing and a recent TikTok discovery page suggest it is still operating, but I could not confirm that from the business's own posts. Side: north_shore.

name: Kolohe Cafe
notes: Own website lists 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku (by Kahuku First Hawaiian Bank). It gives hours of Tue-Sat 8AM-3PM and says closed Sunday and Monday. The Instagram handle 'kolohecafe808' is taken from the business's own Facebook page intro, but I did not open the Instagram page itself. A 2025 Ang Sarap review and a 2026 research page also confirm the business is operating. Side: north_shore.

name: Kooks Coffee
notes: The website URL comes from map and directory listings and I did not open the site itself. The Toast ordering page is the business's own and lists two locations: 575 Cooke St (Kakaʻako) and 2500 Dole St (UH Mānoa campus). Hours shown on Toast for Cooke St are Mon-Sat 7am-2pm. No Instagram or Facebook found, so none given. Side: town.

name: Kupu Food Truck
notes: Run by the nonprofit Kupu at the American Savings Bank campus, 300 N Beretania St, Honolulu. The Kupu Square site lists Mon-Fri 11am-2pm, closed Sat and Sun. The Instagram handle is unclear: a 2022 Star-Advertiser article gives @kupufoodtruck and a 2025 Star-Advertiser article gives @kupuhawaii, which may be the nonprofit's general account. I left it null rather than pick one. Star-Advertiser coverage is from April 2025, so recency is moderate. Side: town.

name: Leonard's Malasadamobile
notes: This is Leonard's Bakery's official Malasadamobile page, listing multiple Oʻahu trucks: Waikele, Pearlridge, Koko Marina, Kaneohe/Windward Mall and others. A March 2026 Hoodline article reports a new Lagoon Drive airport-area truck at 540 Lagoon Dr, citing the official site. Hours vary by truck, so check the page. Leonard's brand Instagram and Facebook were not found in my results, so none given. The seed entry does not say which truck it means. Side: town as per the seed, though several trucks are elsewhere.

name: Little Lotus Express
notes: Only third-party mentions found. Ang Sarap (July 2025) lists it as a Thai/Vietnamese truck at Kahuku Sugar Mill, 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku. No official online presence found. Current status could not be confirmed from non-review sources. Side: north_shore.

name: Mad Fruits
notes: Instagram bio says fruit truck in Kahuku at 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy, Mon-Sat 11-7pm and closed Sunday, which matches the business. A directory listing mentions a Facebook page and the email madfruitshi@gmail.com, but gave no Facebook URL. The Instagram profile snapshot is undated, so still_active is unconfirmed. Ang Sarap (July 2025) also lists the truck at Kahuku Sugar Mill. Side: north_shore.

name: Miguel's Cocina
notes: The handle @miguels.cocina comes from two Honolulu Magazine pieces, including one from late 2025, and matches the truck at 1011 Ala Moana Blvd (Fisherman's Wharf / Kewalo). I did not open the Instagram page. Operator is El Gallo LLC (Miguel Gutierrez). The truck was briefly closed by the Hawaiʻi DOH in Aug 2025 and reopened the next day. Side: town.

name: Mike's Huli Chicken
notes: Own website says Kahuku North Shore food truck, open daily 11:30 AM-7 PM. A 2026 travel guide corroborates the location and hours. The business's Square ordering page (mikeshulichicken.square.site) still references an older Haleiwa North Shore Nut Farm location, so I did not list it as order_url. Older articles mention a Kahaluʻu location, which appears to be historical. No Instagram or Facebook found. Side: north_shore.

name: Nelly's Tacos Mexicano
notes: Only third-party sources found. The truck is at 56-505 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku (Kahuku Food Truck Market, behind Giovanni's), phone (808) 383-4704. A Yahoo Local listing mentions a reopening on Sept 7, 2023 after a temporary closure. No official site or social accounts found. This is not the same as 'Nelly's Tacos Mexicanos' in Wahiawa. Current status is unconfirmed. Side: north_shore.

name: Ohana Hui Cafe
notes: Matcha truck at 747 Queen St, Kakaʻako. Own website says open every day 10-4pm. Instagram handle @ohanahui808cafe comes from Star-Advertiser and Aloha State Daily (Dec 2025), which say to follow it for updates and special events. Owner is David Song. No Facebook found. Side: town.

name: Ono Yo
notes: Frozen yogurt and açaí truck at 56-505 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku. The website onoyohawaii.com is listed on the business's X profile and in Honolulu Magazine. Honolulu Magazine mentions a Facebook page but gave no URL. The X account (@OnoYoHawaii) appears inactive since 2017. A 2020 blog notes it also sold at the Mililani Farmers Market, but no current market schedule was found. Current operating status is unconfirmed from first-party sources. Side: north_shore.

name: Papi's Tacos
notes: The website URL comes from Hawaii Travel Advice (2025), not from the site itself. Truck is at 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku. Recent guides from the last few months (Kokua Hale guide, Strek Adventures) still list it as operating. No Instagram or Facebook confirmed. Side: north_shore.

name: Pit Stop Tacos, Burgers & Sliders
notes: My search for this vendor did not complete, so no official presence was verified. A directory snippet mentioned a 'Pit Stop Hawaii Food Truck' in Honolulu, but I could not tie it to this exact business, so nothing was filled in. Side: town, since the seed says Waikiki.
